content.text: The spread order is reversed, so the existing entity overwrites the payload.

candidates.explanation: The merged object is `{...payload, ...UserMapper.toDomain(entity)}`. The existing DB entity is spread last, so its old values override every field in the update payload (firstName, lastName, role, etc.). The save call then writes the unchanged values and returns them. The request gets 200 OK, but nothing changes in the database.

fix.description: Spread the existing domain user first and the payload last, so the payload overrides the old values: `{...UserMapper.toDomain(entity), ...payload}`.
